feeds.title: ASM Auto Recycling Blog
feeds.description: Keeping you up to date with all the latest news and updates in the world of recycling, scrappage and transport in the UK with the ASM Auto Recycling blog. Established for over 35 years, ASM Auto Recycling is widely regarded as one of the UK's most modern and professional vehicle salvage agents and parts recyclers. We currently process over 30,000 vehicles every year.

feeds.title: Nationwide Auto Recycling Blog
feeds.description: Nationwide Auto Recycling Inc. is a Massachusetts-based salvage yard that has 3 generations and over 52 years of experience selling used auto parts. We take great pride in providing excellent quality used OEM auto parts to customers nationwide. Nationwide Auto Recycling Inc. is owned and operated by family members and honest, hardworking employees focused on customer satisfaction and long-term relationships.

feeds.title: Auto Recycling World
feeds.description: Auto Recycling World is produced by ATF Professional LLP to create awareness of the auto recycling industry, the vital role it plays, and its importance regarding the circular economy of auto manufacturing. The auto recycling world provides news and information for the vehicle recycling industry.

feeds.title: Logel's Auto Parts Blog
feeds.description: The team at Logel's Auto Parts in Kitchener/Waterloo shares their knowledge about automotive recycling, car care, and more in their blog. Logel's Auto Parts specializes in used and new parts, plus the removal and recycling of End of Life Vehicles since 1959.

feeds.title: More Cash For Scrap Blog
feeds.description: Since 2005, we've been specializing in turning our customer's scrap vehicles into quick cash. More Cash For Scrap buys junk cars, trucks, SUVs, vans, and even buses for MORE cash than our competitors. We provide scrap car removal services in all of Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley; from Hope to Whistler and everywhere in between, we buy junk vehicles in ANY condition and tow them away for FREE.

feeds.title: Greenway Auto Recycling Blog
feeds.description: Green Way Auto Recycling is family family-owned Canadian recycling facility that's been in business since 2002. Their blog equips you with the knowledge to approach car recycling confidently and make responsible choices that align with your priorities. Stay tuned for regular posts that cover a range of related topics.

feeds.title: Junk Car Medics Blog
feeds.description: Junk Car Medics gets you more money for your cars, junk cars, and damaged cars. Our process makes selling junk quick, easy, and painless.

feeds.title: Auto Recycling Buyer's Guide
feeds.description: As the voice of the professional automotive recycling industry, the Automotive Recyclers Association (ARA) is deeply committed to meeting the needs of its membership and elevating the professional automotive recycling industry. ARA works to connect those who supply resources, products, and services with the leaders and owners of automotive recycling businesses. This Online Buyer's Guide is one way to bring those who need services to those who supply them.

feeds.title: All Import Auto Parts Blog
feeds.description: Blog about makes, models, and parts for cars and trucks. Buy used auto parts at All Import Auto Parts. All Import Auto Parts grew up on old-school principles, offering quality used auto parts, and competitive prices Our computerized inventory makes finding rare parts easier and less painful while providing the least possible amount of downtime for you, our customer.

feeds.title: Allied Recycling Blog
feeds.description: We recycle scrap metal and junk cars including copper, aluminium, stainless steel, iron, tin, and more in Walpole, Norwood, Quincy, Dedham, Mansfield, Franklin and Framingham, MA. We specialize in auto salvage and recycling, selling used auto parts and providing free pick up and towing for junk cars, visit our website for more information.

feeds.title: Scrap Car Network
feeds.description: When all's said and done, you don't have to scrap your car with Scrap Car Network. There are plenty of scrap metal merchants out there, and you can easily get a few quid for your pocket. That being said, there are a few pretty good reasons to scrap your car with us. Get the latest news and advice on everything related to car scrapping, car breaking, and vehicle recycling on the Scrap Car Network blog.

feeds.title: Top Recyclage Blog
feeds.description: At Top Recyclage, we are committed to making the process of disposing of end-of-life vehicles easy, professional, and environmentally friendly. We understand that getting rid of an old car can be a stressful and confusing process, which is why we've designed our car disposal program to take care of everything for you.

feeds.title: Smart Auto Recycling Blog
feeds.description: We've been GTHA's Best Auto Recycling Scrap Vehicles, metals, and parts for over 15 years. We recycle a large range of ferrous and non-ferrous Cars, and metals, including copper, brass, aluminum, stainless steel, cable, lead, and lead-acid batteries.

feeds.description: Cash 4 Cars Cleveland will buy your scrap car for cash and tow your car for free. We pay the most cash possible for junk cars. feeds.title: Butler Auto Recycling Blog
feeds.description: Butler Auto Recycling has been family-owned and operated in Pensacola, Florida, since 1977. We provide our readers with articles, resources, and industry updates to help you travel a better road ahead!
